summary: Train fighting skills and build your gym in the ultimate MMA & boxing simulator
description: MMA Manager 2 is a high-performance mobile sports management simulator designed for fans of professional combat sports. As the successor to the hit original, this game allows players to step into the role of a professional MMA Manager. You are responsible for scouting athletes, building a world-class gym, and coaching your team to victory in the boxing ring and the MMA cage. Whether you are a fan of UFC™, mixed martial arts, wrestling, or boxing games, this simulator offers the most realistic combat sport experience on mobile. MMA Manager 2 is what every combat sports manager games fans were looking for! Master the Art of Combat Sports Management In the competitive world of MMA -mixed martial arts-, success is forged in the gym. To become a legend, you must manage every aspect of your fighters' careers. * Build Your Dream Gym: Purchase state-of-the-art equipment to create the ultimate MMA training facility. * Recruit the Best Talent: Scout for the next MMA boxing star or a martial arts prodigy. * Train World-Class Athletes: Use your gym to master disciplines and fighting techniques like Muay Thai, BJJ, Kickboxing, Karate, and Sambo. * Strategy & Tactics: Develop a custom game plan for every realistic fight based on your opponent’s weaknesses. How to Build an MMA Empire 1. Hire Expert Coaches: Pick trainers who specialize in specific techniques to give your MMA team the edge. 2. Navigate a UFC Career Mode: Lead your MMA fighters through branching progression paths in multiple weight classes. 3. Dominate the Fight Club: It’s fight night! Test your mettle against the global fighting community in high-stakes online battles. 4. Manage Your Business: As a gym manager, earn credits, prestige, and cash to upgrade your MMA training facility and unlock new moves. Frequently Asked Questions Can I play MMA Manager 2 offline? Yes, MMA Manager 2 features robust single-player campaigns, making it one of the top fighting games offline for sports management fans. Is there a multiplayer mode? Absolutely. You can join the Fight Club to engage in online MMA battles against rivals from around the world to climb the leaderboards. Does the game include boxing? Yes. While it is an MMA-focused game, it functions as a deep boxing simulator, allowing you to train your fighters specifically for striking and boxing matches, as well as different martial arts disciplines, like wrestling, karate, kickboxing and sambo. How do I improve my fighter's rank? By winning battles and consistently training in your gym, your MMA fighters gain experience, unlock improved offensive moves, and advance through the professional ranks. Key Features at a Glance: * Dynamic Action: Strategy-based fights that react to your tactical decisions. * Vast Customization: Train your fighters with exciting new moves and customize their attributes. * Premier League Experience: Compete in tournaments and rise to the top of the MMA combat organization. * Realistic Combat: Experience the intensity of cage fighting with high-fidelity sports simulation mechanics.
